description: Ministry Of Public Security - Immigrants and Emigrants Act(Chapter 351) (The Permanent Residence visa Regulations of 2024).
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Public Security under the Immigrants and Emigrants Act, establishing new legal requirements and procedures for permanent residence visas.
